description: Presidential Secretariat - Amendment to the Gazette Ex. No. 2103/33 of 28.12.2018 that published the Duties and Functions further Amended with effect from 18.03.2019
reasoning: This gazette notification amends the assignment of ministerial portfolios and responsibilities, specifically naming President Maithripala Sirisena as the authority making these changes. It contains both the names of specific ministers (through their portfolio titles) and detailed descriptions of their responsibilities, including specific subjects, departments, statutory institutions, and public corporations under their purview. This meets the criteria for Hybrid (Type 3) as it includes both "who" (government persons) and "what" (detailed government responsibilities/portfolios).
